title: Love this app
body: I’ve been working on creating some habits and this app makes it useful and fun to track my work. It’s rewarding clicking the habit check mark and filling the goals I proposed to myself. Also, you can create many types of habits and track their competition in several ways (liters, km, frequency, etc). Truly love this app 🥰
author: Didi Ramsaran

title: Exelente Diseño
